findings.claim: The plan now allows paths: globs for plugin/, docs/, src/kmctl/ and .github/workflows/, so the done check no longer pushes the builder to strip rule scoping for planned folders.
The loopctl ban is gone; a kept rule may name loopctl as the tool this repository's tickets run on, and the loop workflow is handed to the loop-harness plugin.

The path clause still fails the OKF bundle sections that kmctl's own manifesto defines but that do not exist yet: .okf/architecture/, practices/, proposals/, prototypes/, handoffs/. Today .okf/ holds only decisions/, index.md, log.md and manifesto.md. diagrams-stay-current is about `.okf/architecture/`, okf-bundle lists the sections (and the briefing ticket builds its shipped rules from okf-bundle and docs-layout), docs-layout names `.okf/prototypes/<name>/` and `.okf/proposals/`, and cli-interface, cli-version-floor and skills-are-thin cite `.okf/architecture/cli-and-plugin.md`. Read as written, the check makes the builder delete these true references or drop diagrams-stay-current, the same problem as p1 in a different folder. Fix: allow paths under the .okf/ sections the manifesto names (manifesto.md lines 41-42), and say whether a cited page that does not exist yet, like cli-and-plugin.md, should be dropped or kept.
